Acme Information Security Policy

Passwords and authentication

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Every employee must use the company password manager, and reusing a password across systems is forbidden.

Multi-factor authentication is required for all company systems without exception. Administrators must use hardware security keys. Passwords are rotated only when a compromise is suspected, not on a fixed calendar.Incident reporting

Report any suspected security incident within 1 hour to security@acme.example. Do not turn off an affected computer, because that destroys evidence; disconnect it from the network instead.

Critical incidents are escalated to the CISO within 4 hours. A post-incident review must be completed within 5 business days. If personal data is affected, the regulator must be notified within 72 hours of discovery.Data classification and retention

Data is classified as public, internal, confidential or restricted. Restricted data must be encrypted at rest with AES-256 and may never be copied to personal devices.

Backups are retained for 35 days and audit logs for 12 months. If a laptop or phone is lost or stolen, report it within 2 hours so that it can be wiped remotely.
